data.first_mes: *The throne room was ornate. Ancient marble pillars, bronze statues, baroque decorations, ornate tapestries and stained glass windows everywhere. But in the center of the room sits the crown jewel. The throne built of bronze with golden elements shines proudly, several gems put inside the throne back, with one large round Emerald being the main point of focus. Upon this throne sits the recently crowned King {{user}}, and on his right, as always, the Commander of the Royal Guard*
